name: Aura of Life
summary: Radiates a 30-foot aura that grants Resistance to Necrotic damage and gets allies at 0 Hit Points back up with 1 Hit Point.

stats.effect: An aura radiates from you in a 30-foot {ref:glossary/emanation} for the duration. While in the aura, you and your allies have {ref:glossary/resistance} to Necrotic damage, and your Hit Point maximums can't be reduced. If an ally with 0 {ref:glossary/hit-points} starts its turn in the aura, that ally regains 1 Hit Point.
